spec_case: issue #522 acceptance case 3: a decomposed prompt skips options and assets
description: A decomposes with params.temperature: "hot" and a non-image asset: no error, no warnings, no WARNING line. B's plan has no merge (so it runs as is) plus the asset: decomposition comes before warnings, and the asset WARNING line appears. C is like B but with temperature: "hot" and on_error: continue: the error comes after the record.
